title: Evaluating AST-Derived Knowledge Graph Retrieval for AIOps Incident Diagnosis in Apache Kafka
abstract: arXiv:2611.21625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Incident diagnosis requires retrieving source-linked operational evidence from large codebases. We evaluate graph-augmented retrieval for Apache Kafka using an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-derived ownership graph over 1,600 source-linked log records and an audited benchmark of 315 incident-style queries covering 103 unique targets. Vector-only retrieval is a strong baseline at Recall@20 of 0.956, and neither static nor confidence-guided staged AST expansion significantly improves Recall@20 over it. As an external control we evaluate HippoRAG, a published text-derived graph-retrieval system, against its own ColBERTv2 retrieval backbone. Against ColBERTv2-only (Recall@20 0.803), HippoRAG attained 0.308; a post-hoc document-ensemble sensitivity raised Recall@20 to 0.648 but did not eliminate the deficit. translated_title: 评估基于抽象语法树（AST）的知识图谱检索在Apache Kafka AIOps事件诊断中的应用
translated_abstract: 事件诊断需要从大型代码库中检索与源代码相关联的运维证据。我们使用从抽象语法树（AST）派生的所有权图谱，基于1,600条与源代码关联的日志记录以及315个经审计、涵盖103个独特目标的事件式查询基准，评估了面向Apache Kafka的图增强检索。仅向量检索是一个强基线，Recall@20达到0.956，而无论是静态还是置信度引导的分阶段AST扩展均未能显著提升其Recall@20。作为外部对照，我们评估了HippoRAG（一个已发表的基于文本派生图谱的检索系统）与其自身的ColBERTv2检索骨干：相比仅使用ColBERTv2（Recall@20为0.803），HippoRAG仅达到0.308；事后进行的文档集成敏感性分析将Recall@20提升至0.648，但仍未消除差距。相对于静态扩展，分阶段方法将交叉编码器的配对工作负载和实测重排序时间减少了约52%。（注：原文摘要末尾被截断）
tldr: 本文在Apache Kafka事件诊断任务上系统评估了基于AST派生知识图谱的检索方法，发现仅向量检索已是强基线（Recall@20达0.956）且图增强方法难以显著超越，而分阶段图扩展可将重排序开销减少约52%。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates AST-derived knowledge graph retrieval for AIOps incident diagnosis in Apache Kafka, showing that vector-only retrieval is a strong baseline (Recall@20 of 0.956) that graph-augmented methods fail to significantly improve upon, while staged expansion reduces reranking overhead by about 52%.
